store("attention_wgmma_source", `@avelang.jit
def _attention_gate(
    packed: S.Tensor((416, 5120), S.bf16),
    q: S.Tensor((416, 8, 256), S.bf16),
    k: S.Tensor((416, 2, 256), S.bf16),
    attended: S.Tensor((416, 8, 256), S.bf16),
):
    """One batch/head per CTA; BF16 QK and strictly FP32 softmax/PV."""
    tid = S.thread_id(0)
    warp = tid // 32
    lane = tid % 32
    head = S.block_id(0) % 8
    batch_start = (S.block_id(0) // 8) * 26
    kv_head = head // 4

    ready = S.nvvm.mbarrier_create()
    scores = S.make_shared((32, 32), S.f32, 128)
    v_shared = S.make_shared((4, 2048), S.bf16, 128)
    k_shared = S.make_shared((4, 4096), S.bf16, 128)
    q_shared = S.make_shared((4, 4096), S.bf16, 128)

    q_tensor = S.view(
        q, S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 416, 8, 64), (64, 2048, 256, 1)),
    )
    k_tensor = S.view(
        k, S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 416, 2, 64), (64, 512, 256, 1)),
    )
    v_tensor = S.view(
        S.subview(packed, (0, 4608), (416, 512), (1, 1)), S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 416, 2, 64), (64, 5120, 256, 1)),
    )
    q_map = S.nvvm.make_tma_descriptor(
        q_tensor, S.make_layout((4, 64, 1, 64), (4096, 64, 4096, 1)),
        SWIZZLE_128B,
    )
    k_map = S.nvvm.make_tma_descriptor(
        k_tensor, S.make_layout((4, 64, 1, 64), (4096, 64, 4096, 1)),
        SWIZZLE_128B,
    )
    v_map = S.nvvm.make_tma_descriptor(
        v_tensor, S.make_layout((4, 32, 1, 64), (2048, 64, 2048, 1)), 0,
    )
    S.nvvm.mbarrier_init(ready, 0, count=1, predicate=tid == 0)
    S.nvvm.fence_mbarrier_init_release_cluster()
    S.syncthreads()
    S.nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(ready, 81920, 0, tid == 0)
    q_dst = S.view(
        q_shared, S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 64, 1, 64), (4096, 64, 4096, 1)),
    )
    k_dst = S.view(
        k_shared, S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 64, 1, 64), (4096, 64, 4096, 1)),
    )
    v_dst = S.view(
        v_shared, S.bf16,
        S.make_layout((4, 32, 1, 64), (2048, 64, 2048, 1)),
    )
    S.nvvm.tma_load(
        q_dst, q_map, (0, head, batch_start, 0), ready,
        predicate=tid == 0, expect_tx=False,
    )
    S.nvvm.tma_load(
        k_dst, k_map, (0, kv_head, batch_start, 0), ready,
        predicate=tid == 0, expect_tx=False,
    )
    S.nvvm.tma_load(
        v_dst, v_map, (0, kv_head, batch_start, 0), ready,
        predicate=tid == 0, expect_tx=False,
    )
    S.nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(ready, 0, 10000000, 0)

    if tid < 128:
        accumulators = S.full((1, 32), 0.0, S.f32)
        acc = accumulators[0]
        S.nvvm.wgmma_fence_aligned()
        for chunk in S.range(4, unroll=True):
            qm = S.view(
                S.subview(q_shared, (chunk, 0), (1, 4096), (1, 1)),
                S.bf16, S.make_layout((64, 64), (64, 1)),
            )
            km = S.view(
                S.subview(k_shared, (chunk, 0), (1, 4096), (1, 1)),
                S.bf16, S.make_layout((64, 64), (64, 1)),
            )
            da = S.nvvm.make_wgmma_descriptor_bits(
                qm, SWIZZLE_128B, 0, 0, 0, 16, 1024,
            )
            db = S.nvvm.make_wgmma_descriptor_bits(
                km, SWIZZLE_128B, 0, 0, 0, 16, 1024,
            )
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n64k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da, db, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n64k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 2, db + 2, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n64k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 4, db + 4, acc, 1)
            acc = S.nvvm.wgmma_m64n64k16_f32_bf16_bf16(da + 6, db + 6, acc, 1)
        S.nvvm.wgmma_group_sync_aligned()
        S.nvvm.wgmma_wait_group_sync(0)
        S.nvvm.wgmma_fence_aligned()
        for i in S.range(32, unroll=True):
            accumulators[0, i] = acc[i]
        row0 = warp * 16 + lane // 4
        row1 = row0 + 8
        for group in S.range(4, unroll=True):
            col = group * 8 + (lane % 4) * 2
            if row0 < 26:
                scores[row0, col] = accumulators[0, group * 4] * S.convert(0.0625, S.f32)
                scores[row0, col + 1] = accumulators[0, group * 4 + 1] * S.convert(0.0625, S.f32)
            if row1 < 26:
                scores[row1, col] = accumulators[0, group * 4 + 2] * S.convert(0.0625, S.f32)
                scores[row1, col + 1] = accumulators[0, group * 4 + 3] * S.convert(0.0625, S.f32)
    S.syncthreads()

    for position in S.range(warp, 26, 8):
        score = scores[position, lane]
        if lane > position:
            score = S.convert(-3.4028234663852886e38, S.f32)
        maximum = score
        for shift in S.range(5, unroll=True):
            maximum = S.nvvm.fast_fmax(maximum, S.shuffle_xor(maximum, 1 << shift, 32))
        probability = S.nvvm.fast_exp2((score - maximum) * S.convert(1.4426950408889634, S.f32))
        denominator = probability
        for shift in S.range(5, unroll=True):
            denominator = denominator + S.shuffle_xor(denominator, 1 << shift, 32)
        probability = probability * S.nvvm.fast_rcp(denominator)
        result = S.full((8,), 0.0, S.f32)
        for key_pos in S.range(26, unroll=True):
            p = S.shuffle(probability, key_pos, 32)
            for i in S.range(8, unroll=True):
                v = S.convert(v_shared[i // 2, key_pos * 64 + lane + (i % 2) * 32], S.f32)
                result[i] = S.nvvm.fast_fma(v, p, result[i])
        token = batch_start + position
        for i in S.range(8, unroll=True):
            d = lane + i * 32
            attention = S.convert(S.convert(result[i], S.bf16), S.f32)
            gate = S.convert(packed[token, head * 512 + 256 + d], S.f32)
            sigmoid = S.nvvm.fast_rcp(
                S.convert(1.0, S.f32) + S.nvvm.fast_exp2(-gate * S.convert(1.4426950408889634, S.f32))
            )
            sigmoid = S.convert(S.convert(sigmoid, S.bf16), S.f32)
            attended[token, head, d] = S.convert(attention * sigmoid, S.bf16)
`);
